knowledge.name: Synthetic quality-measure evidence
knowledge.detail: Three fixed measures provide populations, source-recorded closure, review queues, dates, rates, and explicit evidence limitations.

knowledge.name: Synthetic operational cohorts and outreach language
knowledge.detail: Bundled cohorts define aggregate counts, evidence barriers, draft handling routes, and one canonical unsent care-team contact template.

knowledge.name: Clinical, privacy, and review controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules require minimum-necessary synthetic data, validated exclusions and preferences, limitations, and human approval.

intelligence_processing.name: Source-evidence gap analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates records requiring evidence review and the largest queue without deciding eligibility, compliance, or clinical priority.

intelligence_processing.name: Operational cohort organization
intelligence_processing.detail: Groups synthetic evidence-review work by source barrier and handling route while explicitly avoiding clinical risk scoring.

intelligence_processing.name: Privacy-aware outreach drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Produces neutral, unsent language that invites contact with the care team and prohibits claims that care is overdue or a person is eligible.

intelligence_processing.name: Qualitative source-completeness analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates source-recorded closure rates and pairs each measure with its evidence date and reviewer limitation for validation.

intelligence_processing.name: Deterministic intent routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps quality-manager, care-coordinator, and clinical-operations language to four bounded operations and fails closed on unknown identifiers.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a validated Draft experience with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files; web search is removed and publication is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file CareGapClosureAgent through local chat and API routes with read-only, synthetic-only operation handling.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based evidence review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Quality managers, care coordinators, and clinical operations leads receive evidence, limitations, and human review steps.

management_reporting.name: Source-evidence gap report
management_reporting.detail: Shows each measure’s population, source-recorded closure, review queue, and limitation without labeling people overdue or noncompliant.

management_reporting.name: Aggregate cohort review
management_reporting.detail: Reports cohort counts, evidence barriers, and draft routes as operational triage for authorized quality and care-team review.

management_reporting.name: Outreach draft review
management_reporting.detail: Presents the canonical unsent message, eligibility prohibition, privacy checks, and approval route before any authorized operator may act.

management_reporting.name: Qualitative quality dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports source-recorded closure rates, dates, and limitations as completeness signals, not verified performance or compliance.

tools.name: CareGapClosureAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic, read-only operations over fixed synthetic measures and cohorts.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft package with four operation skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing requires separate approval.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from bounded agent or skill evidence.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow
tools.detail: Documented future governed seam for care-coordination context; the current package has no live connection or write permission.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams review and approval
tools.detail: Documented future seam for clinician and care-team collaboration; no message, approval request, or external action is sent.

tools.name: Approved quality and clinical source systems
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for validated measure definitions, exclusions, claims, labs, attribution, and evidence; none is connected now.

tools.name: Authorized outreach workflow
tools.detail: Future downstream seam for approved operators after consent, preference, accessibility, privacy, and clinical review; the agent only drafts.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only privacy boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses aggregate fictional measures and cohorts, never requests live patient data, and limits outputs to minimum-necessary synthetic fields.

supporting_features.name: Four independently routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Gap analysis, cohort review, outreach drafting, and quality dashboard requests remain bounded, deterministic, and separately reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed evidence handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown measure identifiers return no match rather than substituting another record, browsing, enriching, or inventing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Evidence limitations and uncertainty
supporting_features.detail: Every substantive output identifies synthetic evidence, preserves limitations, and avoids unsupported eligibility or compliance conclusions.

supporting_features.name: Clinician and care-team review gates
supporting_features.detail: Quality reviewers validate measures, clinicians own clinical interpretation, and authorized care-team operators approve downstream action.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous outreach or clinical decision
supporting_features.detail: Prevents diagnosis, treatment advice, eligibility decisions, risk scoring, outreach, scheduling, authorization, and record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four strict-isolation cases and four Studio previews passed; the package remains Draft and unpublished until separately authorized.
